name: Genex recommendations
description: Genex's own optional advice for making games: multiplayer patterns, cover craft, where assets can come from, shop design and the player's experience on Genex. Skills an agent reads on demand; none of it is required.

skills.name: multiplayer-patterns
skills.summary: Optional patterns for a multiplayer web game on @genex-ai/multiplayer: choosing connect or matchmake and a preset, menus and lobbies, teams, host authority, quorum, reconnects, testing with two players, and per-genre setups.

skills.name: cover-craft
skills.summary: Optional advice on making a Genex cover picture and clip: choosing the moment, framing for 16:9, working with the game's own light, and comparing a few candidates.

skills.name: asset-sources
skills.summary: Optional advice on where a game's assets can come from (Local Blender, Genex's lanes, code) and how to plan a small asset set.

skills.name: shop-design
skills.summary: Optional advice on a shop players want to buy from on Genex, and on compliant alternatives when a request crosses Genex's hard rules.

skills.name: player-experience
skills.summary: Optional advice on how a Genex web game meets its players: booting before identity, preview builds and saves, capabilities a player can refuse, and pointer lock and fullscreen around Genex sheets.
